notes: THE HIGH ANCHOR. Staged only into the verifier image and never on the agent surface. It is a BAR, not a claim to be the optimum of this space: it is the fastest crossing an authoring search over this harness found, and a submission that reaches or beats it scores 1.0. A cosine decayed to zero from a short 5 percent warmup ends well ABOVE the hold-then-decay recipes on final loss and crosses the target well BEFORE them, because the whole point of holding a peak is quality that arrives after the bar has already been passed.
